description: Post-Delete: for each decommissioned Azure server, delete the per-VM Disk Encryption Set, revoke the DES identity's Key Vault grant, and soft-delete the per-VM key, using only the identifiers the Post-Provision plug-in recorded on the server (azure_cmk_des_id, azure_cmk_key_id, azure_cmk_applied_key_vault_id, azure_cmk_grant_ref). Ownership-verified (DES must still use the recorded key), idempotent and PROVFAILED-safe. Logic in the azure_disk_encryption shared module.
name: Azure CMK - Remove Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
